items.title: Football Travels to First Place Liberty for Halloween Showdown
items.summary: MIAMI — FIU's football program is set for its Saturday afternoon matchup in Lynchburg, Va., taking on Liberty in a Conference USA (CUSA) tilt at 3:30 p.m.

items.title: Football Downed by Middle Tennessee in Weekday CUSA Finale
items.summary: MIAMI — FIU's football program dropped its second-straight game on Tuesday evening in Conference USA (CUSA) play, falling to Middle Tennessee, 26-23, inside Pitbull Stadium.

items.title: Football Preps for Middle Tennessee, Hosts Blue Raiders Tuesday Night in Final Weekday CUSA Game
items.summary: MIAMI — FIU's football team hosts Middle Tennessee on Tuesday evening at 7 p.m. under the lights at Pitbull Stadium for its final Weekday Conference USA (CUSA) game of the 2026 season.

items.title: Football Hosts Next Willie Simmons Coach’s Show Thursday Evening
items.summary: MIAMI — FIU football will host the next 2026 edition of the Willie Simmons Coach's Show on Thursday, Oct. 15, at 6 p.m. from Twin Peaks Doral.

items.title: Football Falls Late to Jax State on Tuesday Night in Weekday CUSA Play
items.summary: JACKSONVILLE, Ala. — FIU's football program battled in a back-and-forth contest at Conference USA (CUSA) leading Jax State on Tuesday, falling 27-24 via a made field goal from the Gamecocks late in the fourth quarter.

items.title: Football’s Czeremcha Earns Special Teams Player of the Week Following Historic Performance
items.summary: DALLAS — FIU football's kicker Robert Czeremcha was honored by Conference USA (CUSA) as Special Teams Player of the Week for his key contributions in FIU's VICE Night win over New Mexico State, as announced by the league office on Monday afternoon.

items.title: Football Faces Off with Jax State in First Road CUSA Game on Tuesday Night
items.summary: MIAMI — FIU's football team travels to Jax State on Tuesday evening for a Weekday Conference USA (CUSA) matchup, airing on ESPNU at 8 p.m. in Jacksonville, Ala.

items.title: Football Single Game Tickets On Sale Now!
FIU Football Season Ticket Renewal Deadline Set For June 6
items.summary: MIAMI – With the highly anticipated first season of the Willie Simmons Era quickly approaching, so too is the deadline for fans to renew their FIU football season tickets by Friday, June 6.
